references.scope: Actual retained CI observations and bytes checked; no native rerun, hardware attestation or independent solver/compiler trust proof.

limits: The reviewer inspected retained CI bytes/logs and immutable Git objects, without rerunning tests/native/solver/model/tokenizer/compiler.
Remote tool identities and source-stability flags are producer records, not independently measured remote hardware or tool binary attestations.
Input task/case hashes and persisted records are checked for consistency; this audit does not independently regenerate all fixtures or establish language/translation soundness.
Distinct test IDs are established within each identified suite only; overlapping suites must not be added into an independent-test denominator.
Human references remain engineering controls: model requests and Agent successes are zero, capacity/model qualification remains false for this CI wrapper.
The 36 native NDU observations are read from the separate job-log result; no new NDU net-benefit or performance claim is made.
